friction_events.description: Initial READY claim and two later Guide role claims returned CREATE_EXISTS/422; worker advanced rather than treating historical ownership as completion.
First claimed Integrator fan-in had all 12 returns consumed concurrently by newer canonical receipts; duplicate successor creation was suppressed and that cycle was not counted productive.
Compact frontier repeatedly offered recoveries past job-local fixed_generation gates, including dynamic-child G3 and platform-wake G4; both were post-claim aborted without substantive mutation.
One post-authority Guide receipt CREATE hit 409 because main moved concurrently; path was confirmed absent and one retry succeeded.
Local checkout could not resolve github.com, so the authority-contract harness was replayed from already fetched canonical clauses and CI evidence was kept separate from the local test claim.
Public /wc/exit/ fetch returned cache miss; the exact gh-pages backing file was read instead before E9 close.
Some embedded artifact timestamps written during the run are ahead of GitHub commit timestamps; exact elapsed calculations were therefore omitted instead of fabricating precision.

decision_trace.decision: Use a fresh identity and never reuse historical worker completion.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Human launch envelope required NUEVO_WORKER=1 and beacon-first durable identity.
decision_trace.action: Created a new beacon with de-novo worker_id and launch_nonce before allocation.
decision_trace.outcome: Fresh worker identity established; all later claims use the same worker_id.

decision_trace.decision: Do not duplicate concurrently consumed Integrator work.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Two newer Guide receipts covered all 12 returns in the claimed fan-in.
decision_trace.action: Persisted a non-productive stale-fan-in receipt and reallocated.
decision_trace.outcome: No duplicate successors; resident work continued.

decision_trace.decision: Treat repeated Supabase Work Trace dependence as a governance compatibility defect, not a reason to bypass explicit denial.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Universal cognitive block was blocked by Supabase transport while current /wc human authority explicitly permits bounded gate override and preserves explicit-denial terminal behavior.
decision_trace.action: Planner materialized a bounded repair plus independent regression, both semantic-pinned before job CREATE.
decision_trace.outcome: Guide Mesh governance aligned with current /wc authority; independent 8-case regression later passed in CI.

decision_trace.decision: Abort stale recovery generations instead of manufacturing repeated work.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Focused dynamic-child verification already passed; platform-wake job declared fixed_generation=3 with no new adapter evidence.
decision_trace.action: Returned two ROUTE_ABORTED records with no substantive mutation.
decision_trace.outcome: Stale recovery evidence became durable and was linked to allocator recovery-policy debt.

decision_trace.decision: Strengthen existing owner capability routing rather than create duplicate repair jobs.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Embedded recovery-policy owner lacked full-source patch capability; async-QA residual required an actual representative JavaScript browser.
decision_trace.action: Updated existing job capsules with precise required capabilities and durable boundary evidence.
decision_trace.outcome: Future claims can be filtered toward compatible runtimes without new scheduler/queue/authority surfaces.

decision_trace.decision: Stop at resident target 6, not checkpoint 3 and not hard cap 8.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Six durable productive slot refs exist and the pool target is 6.
decision_trace.action: Ran universal exit audit and closed E9.
decision_trace.outcome: Resident target reached with six productive units; no extra filler work started.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh PROD-01 worker reached the resident target of 6 productive units. It added and independently verified a bounded Guide human-authority compatibility repair, closed multiple Guide fan-ins without duplicate successors, strengthened capability routing for allocator and browser-dependent work, gated stale private-ingress recovery, and recorded two non-productive stale-recovery aborts. Remaining debt is explicitly owned: embedded/dependency recovery gates, representative browser QA, private-ingress owner repoint, and missing José source evidence.
